digest.component_or_area: CI workflows - tickets branch fetch optimization
propositions: CI workflows must apply --filter=blob:none to all tickets-branch fetch operations to reduce transfer size from ~1.4 GB to ~22-83 MB per checkout
Production guards must validate size-pack via git count-objects -v against declared limits (102400 KiB for standalone, 131072 KiB for Gerrit) immediately after fetch and materialization
Git protocol negotiation must verify server capability advertisement and client filter request via GIT_TRACE_PACKET packet analysis to prove actual partial clone negotiation
Named remote filter inheritance and explicit --filter=blob:none flags on direct URLs must preserve blob:none semantics across all three checkout mechanisms without fetching missing historical blobs
git daemon fixture with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL and uploadpack.allowFilter must enable reproducible protocol testing with deterministic repo state (140+ MiB historical blob removed, tip <1 MiB)
Standalone and Gerrit verify-identity jobs must snapshot git count-objects -v before and after identity scanning to enforce that materialization adds no new promisor objects
